business_scope.primary_industry_name: Public Commercial Web Scraping and Proxy API Gateways

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (continental European tradition; codified commercial law under the Código de Comercio, Decree 410 of 1971; unitary national jurisdiction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Colombia Trade Promotion Agreement (2012, Investment Chapter)
Chile-Colombia Free Trade Agreement (2009, Investment Chapter)
Korea-Colombia Free Trade Agreement (2016, Investment Chapter)
Pacific Alliance Framework Agreement (Mexico, Peru, Chile; investment provisions, 2016)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 1258 of 2008 (SAS regime); Código de Comercio (Decree 410 of 1971), Arts. 110 and 251; Law 526 of 1999 as amended by Law 1121 of 2006 (national AML/CFT framework); Decree 1736 of 2020 (SAGRILAFT obligations codified under Chapter 10 of Decree 1074 of 2015); Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular Externa 100-000016 of 2020; Decree 1674 of 2016 (PEP identification and monitoring); Law 2155 of 2021, Article 43, and DIAN Resolution 164 of 2022 (mandatory UBO register 'RUBF' imposing a 5% ownership or voting-rights threshold and a control-based test); UIAF and Superintendencia Financiera Circular Básica Jurídica guidance on beneficial ownership and SARLAFT.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — UBO data in the RUBF (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales) is filed with DIAN and is protected by statutory tax confidentiality; it is not publicly searchable but is accessible to DIAN, the Superintendencia de Sociedades, UIAF, the Fiscalía General de la Nación and competent judicial authorities upon lawful request.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Good Standing (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal) of the non-resident corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Chamber of Commerce or companies registrar of the shareholder's jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia is a Party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention); consular legalization through a Colombian consulate for non-Hague origin states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate resolution of the foreign shareholder authorizing incorporation of the Colombian S.A.S., fixing subscribed capital, and appointing the local legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors or shareholders' meeting of the foreign corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) granted to the Colombian attorney-in-fact for incorporation formalities
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the country of grant

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport or national identity document of each ultimate beneficial owner and of the designated local legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the country of issuance or issuing government authority

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Ley 1258 de 2008) establishing the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada, Articles 1-48; Código de Comercio (Decree 410 of 1971) Articles 110, 158, 372 and 354-356; Sole Regulatory Decree 1074 of 2015 (mercantile registration); DIAN Resolution 165 of 2023 (electronic invoicing).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Registro Mercantil through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES); tax registration (NIT/RUT) administered by the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument and bylaws) recorded in the Mercantile Registry; raised to a public deed (escritura pública) before a Notaría when real property is contributed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum paid-up capital exists for an S.A.S.; subscribed capital may be nominal (even COP 1) but the unpaid portion must be paid within two years from incorporation (Law 1258 of 2008, Article 24). No escrow account or bank capital-deposit certificate is required, and in-kind contributions are admissible. A nominal capital of COP 1,000,000 is standard, while USD 5,000-10,000 (COP 20-40 million) is recommended for banking and cross-border counterparty due diligence.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Pro-Forma First Board Resolution: RESOLVED: (1) The Company's authorized capital stock of COP 1,000,000, divided into 1,000 ordinary shares of COP 1,000 par value each, is hereby fully subscribed and accepted. Unpaid installments shall be settled per the payment schedule in the bylaws. (2) The registered office is hereby established in Bogotá D.C. at the address filed with the Chamber of Commerce, and all statutory notices shall be received there. (3) The shareholders appoint [Name], identified by passport/cédula [ID], as Legal Representative with executive authority, and [Name] as Compliance and Data Protection Officer. (4) The Legal Representative is directed to obtain the NIT/RUT from DIAN, register the Company before the tax authority, and open the corporate bank account.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — official portal www.dian.gov.co; transactional platform 'MUISCA' for RUT enrolment, e-invoicing, VAT returns and refunds; chambers of commerce act as front-end incorporation registrars.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Execute the S.A.S. by-laws in a private document before a notary or the Chamber of Commerce of the registered office and obtain the pre-RUT registration. 2) File the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) application in MUISCA to obtain the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria), selecting the tax responsibilities: IVA Responsable, Retenedor de IVA/ICA, and Exporter of Services. 3) Appoint a Colombian-resident legal representative for the foreign shareholder and register the foreign investment with the Banco de la República (FX channel) not later than the first foreign exchange transaction. 4) Maintain the RUT permanently updated; the NIT is the sole statutory tax ID for all e-invoicing and customs processes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the S.A.S. is a Colombian tax resident (incorporated under Colombian law) fully subject to the corporate income tax (Impuesto sobre la Renta y Complementarios) at 35% (FY2024-2025) on worldwide income. No pass-through election exists; dividends distributed to non-resident shareholders are additionally subject to dividend withholding tax at the shareholder level.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not operate a 'check-the-box' or hybrid-mismatch election: the S.A.S. is mandatorily a taxable corporation. Available elective mechanisms: (a) election to file under the SIMPLE integrated small-business regime instead of the ordinary regime (annual gross revenue ≤ 100,000 UVT and low asset thresholds; combined rates 1.8%–14.5%), although exporters normally remain in the ordinary regime to preserve VAT-input refunds; (b) unilateral foreign tax credit election against Colombian corporate tax under E.T. Art. 254 for taxes paid abroad; (c) election of the monthly or bimonthly VAT refund cycle for exporters (E.T. Art. 485).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax ('IVA' — Impuesto sobre las Ventas); general tariff 15% from 1 Jan 2025 under Law 2335/2024 (previously 19%); differentiated tariffs 0%, 5% and 10% apply to specified goods and services; exports of services are excluded (zero-rated).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 184,256,300 (3,700 UVT; UVT 2025 = COP 49,799) of taxable sales during the preceding 12 months — E.T. Art. 437 as amended by Law 2277/2022. Regardless of the threshold, the S.A.S. must register as an IVA responsible because it acts as exporter/importer of digital services, and registration is mandatory to claim VAT input refunds.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time 'Factura Electrónica de Venta' (FEV) regime applicable to all IVA-responsible taxpayers. Invoices are issued through DIAN-certified software or authorized e-invoicing providers and transmitted in XML to DIAN's e-invoicing platform (MUISCA/RADIAN) for synchronous validation before delivery; each invoice must carry the CUDE unique electronic code, a 2D QR/electronic stamp, and the NIT; treasury controls apply to refunds.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of intangible API-enabled services (data hosting, scraping-as-a-service, licensing, remote support) are zero-rated/excluded from IVA under E.T. Art. 481 and Decree 1625/2016 Title 1.6 Chapter 12 when: (i) the beneficiary has no Colombian domicile (no PE in Colombia); (ii) the service is effectively used and economically exploited exclusively abroad; (iii) the remuneration is paid and settled through the Colombian foreign exchange market within the legal term; and (iv) export documentation (contract, invoice, declaration of export of services) is completed through MUISCA before the remittance. Crypto-asset remittances not settled through authorized FX intermediaries do not satisfy condition (iii) and expose the zero-rating to challenge.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación de Servicios) filed in the MUISCA/DIAN foreign-trade module identifying the service, beneficiary and invoice

Bill of Lading/transport-equivalent — for intangibles the statutory substitute is the signed export service contract and the FEV e-invoice evidencing delivery of the API/data service and the agreed remittance
Inward Remittance Certificate — the 'Declaración de Cambio' and the settlement statement issued by the Colombian commercial bank proving the receipt of foreign currency (Formulario Único de Cambio)
Technical/service description dossier demonstrating exclusive use and economic benefit abroad
Certified e-invoice with CUDE and the proof of DIAN validation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN will recharacterize the operation as a sale of taxable digital services in Colombia if any zero-rating condition fails, assessing IVA (15%) plus monthly moratory interest from the original due date, and disallowing/recapturing input VAT refunds (including interest on the clawed-back amounts). The 'sanción por inexactitud' (E.T. Art. 648) may reach 160% of the understated tax, and fraudulent export/refund schemes trigger criminal tax-fraud liability (Law 1762/2015 — imprisonment 4 to 9 years) for the legal representative and the technical directors, in addition to NIT suspension and cancellation of e-invoicing authorizations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia), with FX regulation under Resolution 8 of 2000 and Law 9 of 1991; administrative implementation by the Financial Superintendence of Colombia and DIAN

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (COP/USD savings and checking) and specialized forex accounts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial registry renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce where the registered office is domiciled)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January to 31 March of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal penalties per Cámara de Comercio tariff; commercial registration is suspended after approximately six months and may be administratively cancelled if renewal remains unpaid.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and settlement (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios, Form 210)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually as per DIAN's tax calendar, generally between July and September based on the last NIT digit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty equal to 5% of the tax assessed plus daily default interest; continued non-compliance can trigger compulsory collection and suspension of the RUT.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually per DIAN resolution; typical deadline window April to July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines for late, incomplete, or inaccurate filing under the Colombian Tax Code, up to 1,000 UVT; administrative strike-off does not apply.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ultimate beneficial owner report (Reporte de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually per DIAN-issued deadline, normally between June and August
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Specific DIAN penalties for late or incorrect filing; persistent non-filing can affect the validity of the entity's tax registration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory statutory audit and 'revisoría fiscal' are required when total gross assets exceed 5,000 UVT or annual gross revenue exceeds 3,000 UVT, or when the company has 30 or more shareholders; otherwise the audit is optional.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: NIIF/IFRS as adopted in Colombia by Decreto 2420/2015 and subsequent modifications; small and medium-sized SAS entities generally apply NIIF para Pymes, while larger entities apply full IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Any shareholding transfer must be authorized per the SAS bylaws and recorded in the register of members; the annual UBO report to DIAN must be filed even when no ownership changes occurred during the fiscal year.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Socios o Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Registro de Miembros de Junta Directiva)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas y Junta Directiva)
